items.question: Why does node2vec's rigid one-hop neighborhood definition make it insensitive to both homophily and structural equivalence in networks?
items.false_premise: node2vec uses a rigid one-hop neighborhood definition that makes it insensitive to both homophily and structural equivalence.
items.correction: node2vec defines a flexible notion of a node’s network neighborhood and can learn representations that organize nodes based on their network roles and/or communities they belong to.
items.evidence_quote: Our key contribution is in defining a flexible notion of a node’s network neighborhood.

items.question: How does node2vec rely on convolutional filters instead of random walks to generate network neighborhoods for nodes?
items.false_premise: node2vec uses convolutional filters rather than random walks to generate network neighborhoods.
items.correction: node2vec uses a 2 nd order random walk approach to generate (sample) network neighborhoods for nodes.
items.evidence_quote: We use a 2 nd order random walk approach to generate (sample) network neighborhoods for nodes.

items.question: What makes node2vec optimize its objective with Adam rather than stochastic gradient descent on a single hidden-layer feedforward neural network?
items.false_premise: node2vec optimizes its objective with Adam rather than SGD on a single hidden-layer feedforward neural network.
items.correction: The objective can be efficiently optimized using stochastic gradient descent (SGD) akin to backpropogation on just single hidden-layer feedforward neural networks.
items.evidence_quote: The objective can be efficiently optimized using stochastic gradient descent (SGD) akin to backpropogation on just single hidden-layer feedforward neural networks.

items.question: Compared with DeepWalk, why does node2vec only learn embeddings for nodes that share the same community and ignore nodes with similar structural roles?
items.false_premise: node2vec only learns embeddings for nodes in the same community and ignores nodes with similar structural roles.
items.correction: node2vec can learn representations that organize nodes based on their network roles and/or communities they belong to.
items.evidence_quote: By choosing an appropriate notion of a neighborhood, node2vec can learn representations that organize nodes based on their network roles and/or communities they belong to.
